start: on the floor on hands and knees in a low kneeling plank, forearms flat on the floor with elbows under the shoulders, hips low and sagging, knees on the floor, head down.
end: full forearm plank: forearms flat on the floor, elbows under the shoulders, body in one long straight line from head to heels, hips level with the shoulders, legs straight, only toes and forearms touching the floor, head neutral looking at the floor.
notes: Same body, same forearm position in both poses; toes or feet at the same place on the floor line.

start: lying on the floor on one side facing the viewer, bottom forearm flat on the floor with the elbow under the shoulder, legs straight and stacked, hips resting on the floor, top hand on the top hip.
end: side plank: bottom forearm flat on the floor, elbow under the shoulder, hips lifted high so the body is a straight diagonal line from head to feet, legs straight and stacked, only the forearm and the side edge of the bottom foot touching the floor, top hand on the top hip.
muscles: side of the waist (obliques), the upper side of the body

start: lying flat on the back on the floor, legs straight together, arms straight overhead on the floor, body long.
end: hollow body hold: lying on the back, lower back pressed into the floor, shoulders and head lifted off the floor, arms straight overhead by the ears, legs straight together and lifted a little above the floor, body forming a shallow banana curve, only the lower back touching the floor.

start: lying on the back on the floor, both arms pointing straight up to the ceiling, both hips and knees bent at 90 degrees with the shins parallel to the floor and the knees above the hips, lower back flat on the floor.
end: lying on the back, the RIGHT arm extended straight back overhead lying just above the floor beside the head, and the LEFT leg extended straight out just above the floor; the LEFT arm still pointing straight up to the ceiling and the RIGHT leg still bent at 90 degrees with the knee above the hip. Both extended limbs clearly visible and far from the bent ones.

start: on all fours on the floor, hands directly under the shoulders, knees directly under the hips, back flat and level like a table, head neutral looking down, all limbs on the floor.
end: bird dog: on all fours, one arm reached straight forward level with the body and the opposite leg extended straight back level with the body, so arm, back and leg form one straight horizontal line, the other hand and knee on the floor, back flat, head neutral.
notes: Same body and same supporting hand and knee position in both poses.

start: side plank position facing the viewer on the floor: bottom forearm flat on the floor, elbow under the shoulder, hips low and resting near the floor, top leg resting straight along the top of a low flat bench, top foot on the bench, bottom leg bent with the knee on the floor.
end: Copenhagen plank: bottom forearm flat on the floor, elbow under the shoulder, top leg straight with the inside of the top foot or shin resting on top of a low flat bench, bottom leg straight and lifted off the floor under the bench level, body one straight line from head to feet, hips high.
muscles: inner thigh (adductors) of the top leg
notes: The bench is a simple low dark grey flat box, same place in both poses.

start: standing tall seen from the side, feet shoulder width apart, both hands clasped together holding a small handle right at the centre of the chest, elbows bent, a thick straight dark grey cable running from the handle sideways to a small pulley at chest height next to the body.
end: same stance and same body, both arms pressed straight out in front of the chest at shoulder height, hands clasped on the handle, the same thick cable still running level from the handle to the pulley.
muscles: side of the waist and abs (obliques, the core)
notes: Figure large, filling most of the height. Cable is one thick straight short line kept close to the body so the figure stays large. Same body and feet in both poses.
